item.title: UCJ's Accreditation Review Team to visit the Campus March 16-18
item.description: The UWI, Mona will host the University Council of Jamaica (UCJ) Review Team from March 16 to 18, 2026, as they conduct a site visit for the Campus’ Institutional Re-accreditation. Accreditation is a vital process that validates our institutional quality, ensuring that we consistently meet and uphold the highest standards of academic excellence. The UWI, Mona first earned Institutional Accreditation in 2012 and was subsequently granted a maximum seven-year re-accreditation in 2019.

item.title: The UWI, Mona Appoints Manager for New Marketing, Communications, and Alumni Partnerships Unit
item.description: The University of the West Indies, Mona Campus, is pleased to announce the appointment of Ms Natonia Sylva as Manager - Marketing, Communications & Alumni Partnerships, with effect from March 2, 2026. The newly established Marketing, Communications, and Alumni Partnerships Unit within the Office of the Principal marks a strategic shift towards enhanced visibility, greater efficiency, and sustained value for our stakeholders.
